cohort: Same 60 fixed IDs (development50 + training_excluded10), including expired and zero-coverage contracts. No replacement.
integrity: Evaluate exactly once after source freeze; report regardless of outcome.
interpretation: Historical retrospective replay; dependent observations; convenience cohort. Not prospective, not news value, not trading profit.
model_freeze: Same frozen bundles hashed in the 25 October replication. No calibration, refit, threshold or eligibility change.
objective: Fresh out-of-time test of the unchanged May7-9 quote-change booster on an unopened week three weeks after training. No new fit or model selection.
primary: Row-weighted matched log loss of row_hgb7 vs activity_logit, separately development50 and training_excluded10. Pass = lower LL than activity_logit and global_rate on development50 with no higher Brier.
reporting_floor: Fewer than 100 known outcomes, 20 positives or 20 negatives in a cohort = insufficient for comparison.
secondary: Brier, AP, AUC, family-macro LL, per-date, per-contract, strict, nonoverlap, calibration bins, missing-label bounds, contract-clustered bootstrap CI of LL difference (added as analysis-only, reported regardless of sign).
source: 168 hourly pmxt archive files; same fetch code, caps and single transport retry as 25 October.
target: Endpoint midpoint differs after 30 minutes by >1e-12; unchanged 18 features and freshness/endpoint gates.
unopened_basis: No quote-change study has read June prices. Window is before consumed OOT [2026-07-23,2026-07-30], V3.1 [2026-07-22,2026-08-08) and V4 [2026-09-06,2026-10-30); 1231 protected IDs filtered at decode.
